title: Service Contracts: countersignature window and latest effective date by tier
content:
## Scope
This reference covers two timing figures of an Aurelia Hanse Line (AHL) Service Contracts offer, set per tier: how many calendar days after the offer the customer has to countersign, and how many calendar days after the offer the contract's effective date may lie at the latest.

## Parameters by tier
| Tier | Countersignature window (calendar days after the offer) | Latest effective date (calendar days after the offer) |
|---|---|---|
| AHL Starter Service Contract | 14 | 30 |
| AHL Standard Service Contract | 14 | 30 |
| AHL Regional Account Contract | 21 | 45 |
| AHL Key Account Contract | 21 | 45 |
| AHL Global Account Contract | 30 | 60 |
| AHL Strategic Partner Contract | 30 | 60 |

Both figures are whole calendar days and both are counted from the date the offer was issued.

## Tier notes
- The tiers pair off: Starter and Standard share one pair of figures, Regional Account and Key Account share a second, Global Account and Strategic Partner share a third.
- Moving from the first pair to the second adds 7 days to the countersignature window and 15 days to the latest effective date; moving from the second pair to the third adds 9 days and 15 days respectively.

## Quick questions
**An AHL Key Account Contract offer was issued today. Within how many days must the customer countersign?** Within 21 calendar days after the offer.

**How far after the offer may an AHL Global Account Contract take effect at the latest?** 60 calendar days after the offer.

**Is the countersignature window the same for an AHL Starter Service Contract and an AHL Standard Service Contract?** Yes, 14 calendar days for both.
